review_notes: Every edge was checked against the named file in that project's source before it was added. A skill is only linked to a project that actually uses it.
`skill` must match an entry in content/skills.json exactly. tests/content/explorer.test.ts enforces this.
Edges go beyond the resume starter list where the source shows it: TF-IDF and Cosine Similarity in StudyForge AI, and FastAPI, SQLite, Gemini and a keyword-ranked knowledge base in InterviewIQ.
No ratings, percentages or experience scores belong in this file.

skills.label: RAG
skills.explanation: Retrieval-augmented generation finds relevant source text first, so a result rests on real material and not on a model's memory.

skills.label: NLP
skills.explanation: Natural language processing turns human text into signals, scores or vectors that software can work with.

skills.label: OCR
skills.explanation: Optical character recognition reads the text inside an image and returns it as characters.

skills.label: TF-IDF
skills.explanation: TF-IDF weights a word by how often it appears in one text and how rare it is across the collection, turning text into comparable vectors.

skills.label: Cosine Similarity
skills.explanation: Cosine similarity scores how closely two vectors point in the same direction, which ranks texts by how alike they are.

skills.label: Recommendation Systems
skills.explanation: A recommendation system ranks items from a catalogue by how well they match a person's profile.

skills.label: Scikit-learn
skills.explanation: A Python machine-learning library. These projects use its TF-IDF vectorizer and cosine-similarity functions.

skills.label: Gemini API
skills.explanation: Google's generative model API, called here through the GenAI SDK to write, evaluate and personalize text.

skills.label: FastAPI
skills.explanation: A Python framework for building REST APIs, with request validation through Pydantic models.

skills.label: SQLite
skills.explanation: A file-based SQL database that needs no separate server, which suits local-first applications.

skills.label: Streamlit
skills.explanation: A Python framework for building data application interfaces without a separate frontend codebase.

skills.label: JWT Authentication
skills.explanation: Signed JSON Web Tokens let a server confirm who is calling an API without storing a session.

skills.label: React
skills.explanation: A JavaScript library for building interfaces from reusable components.

skills.label: TypeScript
skills.explanation: JavaScript with static types, which catches a class of errors before the code runs.

skills.label: Vite
skills.explanation: A frontend build tool and development server with fast hot reloading.

skills.label: Tailwind CSS
skills.explanation: A utility-first CSS framework for building interfaces directly in markup.
